days.d20271002: Saying yes to everything is just saying no to yourself, slowly.
days.d20271003: If it costs you your peace, it's too expensive. Even on sale.
days.d20271004: You're not behind. You're on your own bloody timeline.
days.d20271005: You don't need another bloody plan. You need to do the thing.
days.d20271006: Comparison is a thief, and a liar. Stop letting her in the front door.
days.d20271007: Not everything is your responsibility. Stop collecting other people's problems.
days.d20271008: Let people be disappointed. They'll survive. So will you.
days.d20271009: Some things need your attention. Others need you to stop giving a shit.
days.d20271010: You've done harder things before breakfast. This is not the hill.
days.d20271011: If they wanted it done their way, they could have done it themselves. Let them.
days.d20271012: Stop explaining yourself to people committed to misunderstanding you.
days.d20271013: You are not the unpaid project manager of everyone else's life.
days.d20271014: Being the reliable one is lovely, right up until it's a full-time unpaid job.
days.d20271015: Decisions don't improve by marinating in your head for three weeks. Pick one.
days.d20271017: Stop rehearsing arguments in the shower. Have the conversation or let it go.
days.d20271018: If you keep moving the deadline, it's not a deadline. It's a suggestion.
days.d20271019: You can't pour from an empty cup, and doom-scrolling is not a refill.
days.d20271020: Stop shrinking to make other people comfortable. Stretch.
days.d20271021: Done and out the door beats perfect and rotting in your drafts.
days.d20271022: Choose your hard: the awkward conversation now, or the resentment later.
days.d20271023: You're allowed to change your mind. You're a grown woman, not a contract.
days.d20271024: Don't let one bad hour talk you into believing it's a bad life.
days.d20271025: Have the fun. The laundry will still be there. It always bloody is.
days.d20271026: Other people's urgency is not your emergency.
days.d20271027: You don't owe anyone a version of you that's permanently available.
days.d20271028: Stop polling people about a decision you've already made. You know the answer.
days.d20271029: Ask for what you want. Hinting is a terrible delivery service.
days.d20271030: Stop tolerating shit you'd never accept on behalf of your best friend.
days.d20271031: The plan doesn't care how you feel. Do ten minutes and see who wins.
days.d20271101: You're the main character. Stop doing the extras' jobs for free.
days.d20271102: Not every fire is yours to put out. Some people just like the warmth.
days.d20271103: Helping is generous. Rescuing grown adults from their own choices is a hobby you can quit.
days.d20271104: Money talk, hard talk, awkward talk: it's all just talk. You have a mouth. Use it.
days.d20271105: Your calendar is a confession of what you actually value. Read it and adjust.
days.d20271106: Your future self is begging you to do the boring thing today.
days.d20271107: Being underestimated is fun. Use it.
days.d20271108: If it's not a hell yes, it's a polite no and an early night.
days.d20271109: Tidy desk, tidy mind? Nice theory. Do the actual work first.
days.d20271110: Nobody is coming to give you permission. Consider this a forged permission slip.
days.d20271111: Perfectionism is procrastination wearing expensive shoes.
days.d20271112: One brave email can save you three weeks of quiet dread.
days.d20271113: You've survived worse than an awkward conversation. Send the bloody email.
days.d20271114: Joy isn't frivolous. It's fuel. Go and get some.
days.d20271115: 'No' is a complete sentence. It doesn't need a footnote, an apology and three alternative dates.
days.d20271116: If someone only calls when they need something, that's not a friendship. That's a helpdesk.
days.d20271117: Rest isn't a reward for finishing everything. Nothing is ever finished. Sit down.
days.d20271118: You can't edit a blank page. Write the crap first draft.
days.d20271119: Being busy is not a personality. Neither is being exhausted.
days.d20271120: Make the call. The dread is always worse than the actual conversation.
days.d20271121: Courage is mostly doing it anyway with a slightly sweaty face.
days.d20271122: Finish one thing properly today. Then pour yourself something nice.
days.d20271123: Guilt is not a to-do list. Check if it's earned. If not, bin it.
days.d20271124: You're not too much. Some people just have very small cups.
days.d20271125: Anyone annoyed by your boundaries was doing very nicely out of you not having any.
days.d20271126: Quitting the wrong thing isn't failure. It's admin.
days.d20271127: Your inbox is a list of other people's priorities. Read it like one.
days.d20271128: Life's short. Wear the good earrings on a Tuesday.
days.d20271129: Stop waiting to feel ready. Ready is a myth sold by people with nothing to do.
days.d20271130: You don't have to fix it today. You just have to stop pretending it isn't there.
days.d20271201: Delegating isn't lazy. It's where you stop pretending you're four people.
days.d20271202: You've been right far more often than you give yourself credit for. Trust that.
days.d20271203: Overthinking is just worrying in a nicer outfit.
days.d20271204: It's fine to outgrow people, places and plans. Snakes shed their skin and they're doing great.
days.d20271205: If you wouldn't let a friend talk to herself like that, shut it down.
days.d20271206: Every 'I'll just quickly…' is a lie you're telling your calendar.
days.d20271207: You can be lovely and still say 'that doesn't work for me.'
days.d20271208: Show up a bit messy. Polished is overrated and takes too damn long.
days.d20271209: Lower the bar. Step over it. Celebrate like you cleared it at the Olympics.
days.d20271210: The 'right time' is a unicorn. Saddle up a horse and go.
